00044     double& process (double& sig) {
00045         m_peak = m_follow->process (sig);
00046         //std::cout << "peak    : " << m_peak << std::endl;
00047                     
00048         m_data[m_index] = hamming (sig, m_index, m_size);
00049         ++m_index;      
00050             
00051         double filtered = m_block->process (sig);
00052         for (int k = 0; k < m_levels; k++) {
00053             filtered = m_filters[k]->fastProcess (filtered);
00054         }       
00055         
00056         if (m_index == m_size) {    
00057             m_index = 0;
00058             wavelet::wt1 (m_data, 1, wavelet::pwt);
00059             waveletSpectrum ();
00060 //          m_peak = findSpectralPeak () / m_totBand;
00061 
00062             if (m_peak >= m_threshold) {
00063                 double c = linearCentroid () / m_totBand;
00064                 //std::cout << "centroid: " << c << std::endl;
00065                 for (int k = 0; k < m_levels; k++) {
00066                     m_filters[k]->cutoff (c * m_bias);
00067                 }
00068             }
00069         }
00070     
00071         double t = m_zero->process (filtered);
00072         if (t > MIN_FREQ_LIMIT && m_peak >= m_threshold) {
00073             m_val = m_final->fastProcess (t);
00074         }
00075         else {
00076             m_val = -1;
00077         }
00078             
00079         return m_val;

00102     void waveletSpectrum () {
00103         int endp = 1;
00104         int start = 1;
00105         int exp = 0;
00106         while (endp <= m_size) {
00107             double power = 0;
00108             for (int i = start; i < endp; ++i) {

00110             }
00111

00113             else m_bands[exp] = 0;
00114             
00115             start = endp;

00118         }
00119     }
